summary: Approved as a polished launch photograph: one coherent ivory-and-brass appliance is grounded on the requested slate counter, exactly three capsules form a restrained foreground diagonal, the 85 mm-style perspective and shallow cafe background read naturally, and soft window light plus a warm brass rim produce premium editorial depth.
knownLimitations: The recessed indicator reads as a small dark opening on the lid rather than a visibly illuminated status point.
